selectionGuidance.idle: Select four coherent poses per direction; use only frames depicting the same wolf proportions and markings.
selectionGuidance.walk: Select six frames per direction from the three displayed pose rows; keep the contact shadow and ground line stable.
selectionGuidance.attack: Select six anticipation, lunge, impact and recovery poses; gameplay contact should visually align with frame 4.
selectionGuidance.death: Select six progressive collapse frames and hold the last frame briefly.

normalization.west: mirror east unless visual asymmetry requires a dedicated row
